visual.wcag-aa-contrast.requirement: Declared semantic text and UI-boundary pairs meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast thresholds in every supported mode.

visual.wcag-aaa-report.requirement: AAA contrast gaps are reported as advisory evidence and are not silently presented as AA failures.

visual.composition-spacing.requirement: Page patterns use declared composition spacing roles and preserve their rendered relationship at supported viewports.

visual.responsive-geometry.requirement: Approved pattern stories have no unexpected overflow, overlap, clipped controls, or undersized interactive targets at required viewports.

visual.baseline-review.requirement: New or intentionally changed visual snapshots require explicit human review before the baseline is accepted.

visual.typography-density.requirement: Typography roles use the declared dense-data scale, preserve readable line height, and remain documented for human and AI consumers.

visual.elevation-hierarchy.requirement: Compositions use spacing and typography before adding a separator or independent surface, and components use the smallest declared elevation role that communicates a real stacking relationship.

visual.interaction-state-contrast.requirement: Default, hover, checked, selected, and disabled-adjacent interactive color pairs preserve WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in supported modes and brands.
